Nasus.build: Nasus’s main damage comes from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, so prioritize armor. Armor doesn’t work against Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so leave the area and avoid stacking health alone against Nasus R Fury of the Sands.
Nasus.teamfight: Don’t face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance and attack. When allies have caught an enemy or you have an angle to reach several enemies from out of vision, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken in that order. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, make sure allies can follow immediately.
Nasus.combo: When Nasus steps up to last-hit, apply the first stack of Kennen P Mark of the Storm with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If you can’t apply the third mark right away, delay your combo because the stacks may expire.
Nasus.escape: If you used Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no way out, so don’t go deep while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.fight: Early on, use your range to damage Nasus when he steps up to last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don’t force a fight; create distance and wait it out.
Nasus.laning: Don’t keep pushing the lane in, or Nasus will be able to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike comfortably under his turret. Let the lane come to you, then poke Nasus when he steps up to last-hit or call for a jungle gank. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Nasus.phase: Early on, Kennen can use his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to disrupt Nasus’s stacking. In the late game, accumulated Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks put you at a disadvantage, so don’t face him head-on; keep your distance.
Nasus.watch: If you are hit by Nasus W Wither, your movement and attack speed drop, so don’t move alone within Nasus’s range. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so don’t stay in its area. While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting unless you have a clear advantage in numbers or damage.

Yone.fight: When Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado isn’t ready, use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If you’ve applied two marks, add the third and stun Yone when he steps up to last-hit. Kennen E Lightning Rush is your only escape, so before using it to engage, check Yone’s remaining movement abilities and whether your allies can follow.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several of you, and don’t stand alone at the very back of your formation where Yone R Fate Sealed can reach you. When an ally has locked down an opponent or you can enter from the flank out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to build marks on several enemies.
Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the spots telegraphed by Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave. Yone deals mixed damage, so don’t stack resistance in only one direction. Activating Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom increases both armor and magic resistance.
Yone.escape: The opening to engage is when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado has disappeared and Yone E Soul Unbound is down. Yone has several movement abilities, so don’t overcommit just because one is down; look especially for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up.
Yone.laning: Back off when Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, and don’t throw Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken at Yone if he’s behind minions. If you push the lane, get river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Yone.phase: Yone is weak early, so pressure him with Kennen’s range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke. Late game, Kennen is easy to kill, so focus on surviving until you can find an engage angle.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado is being prepared, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Save a way to complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun when Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits, so just before a teamfight, check that you aren’t alone at the very back of your formation.

Akali.teamfight: Activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when your team has caught someone or you can flank a group of enemies from out of vision. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, go in when your team can follow immediately; otherwise, save it to escape after Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom. If Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution are available, she can stick to you, so check her position before engaging.
Akali.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali's damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. Akali's high magic resistance can easily block Kennen's magic damage, so include penetration as well.
Akali.combo: Apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken when Akali steps up to last-hit. When engaging with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken when the enemies are grouped together.
Akali.escape: Check whether the slow from Akali Q Five Point Strike is down too. If only one of Akali's mobility tools is down, she can escape with the other, so don't rush the chase.
Akali.fight: Don't overextend to chase Akali while she's hidden in Akali W Twilight Shroud; retaliate when she comes out and attacks. Look for an opening to catch her with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom while Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable.
Akali.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken can't hit Akali when she's behind minions, so first find an angle to land it. If you've applied two marks, continue the trade only when you can immediately apply the third with Kennen W Electrical Surge. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Akali.phase: When Akali R Perfect Execution is available, watch for her engage and its second hit, which scales with your missing health, and look for an opening while her ultimate is unavailable. Kennen peaks in the mid game, but his low health later means you need to choose your engage carefully.
Akali.watch: You can hit Akali with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken during the brief moment she appears just after entering Akali W Twilight Shroud.

Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge targets you, stand against a wall to prevent all four vitals from being triggered. When your team has caught an enemy or you have an angle to hit several enemies from out of vision, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, then Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, go in when your team can follow immediately; otherwise, save it to disengage.
Fiora.laning: Use your range to poke melee opponent Fiora with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but find an angle to hit her since minions block the shuriken. If you've stacked two marks, look for the moment Fiora steps up to last-hit when you have a way to apply the third. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Resistances can't block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, and Fiora R Grand Challenge scales with maximum health, so be cautious about stacking large amounts of health alone. If the duel is likely to drag on, build resistances, then consider Grievous Wounds.
Fiora.combo: The basic sequence is Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken for the first mark, a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge's passive for the second, then use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and stun. If Fiora W Riposte is available, she can parry the stun, so bait out Riposte or sidestep its counterstrike before completing the sequence. If Kennen W Electrical Surge's empowered attack isn't ready, don't use its active effect first.
Fiora.escape: The moment after baiting out Fiora Q Lunge is a window to close the gap and trade briefly. If Fiora W Riposte is down too, you have a chance to complete the stun, but account for the fact that engaging with Kennen E Lightning Rush also uses up your escape.
Fiora.fight: Poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken while avoiding Fiora's vital side. When Fiora steps up to last-hit, complete the stun with Kennen W Electrical Surge's ready empowered attack and active effect. If Fiora W Riposte is available, don't use all the tools needed to complete the stun at once. After a short trade, don't chase recklessly; check whether you can use Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage.
Fiora.phase: Mid game is Kennen's peak, when he has an engage tool and ability power, so look for opportunities when Fiora W Riposte and Fiora Q Lunge are down.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte can block the stun from Kennen P Mark of the Storm and stun you in return, so don't rush to apply the third mark while Riposte is available. If Fiora Q Lunge dashes toward a vital, move to the opposite side of it and counterattack briefly. If you're hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stand against a wall to avoid exposing all four vitals.

Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock up several of you. If you can’t see Malphite, don’t prepare to engage from a clustered position. Go in immediately after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, or when an ally has caught an enemy, and approach from the flank and out of vision to reach several enemies.
Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable charge and cannot be interrupted by Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun. When you can’t see Malphite, don’t stand close to allies near walls or bushes. Don’t start a trade right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits and slows you.
Malphite.combo: After Malphite P Granite Shield breaks, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Before applying the second mark, make sure you can follow up with the third.
Malphite.escape: Don’t go in while slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, account for the fact that you’ll also be using your way out.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Delay the trade immediately after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you.
Malphite.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken is blocked by minions, so find a position where it can hit Malphite when he is standing behind them. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Malphite.phase: Early on, use Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to take lane control and draw jungle ganks to slow Malphite’s growth. Kennen peaks in the mid game once he has his engage item and ability power. In the late game, he is fragile, so choose your engage carefully.
Malphite.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Malphite’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first. Slot Banshee’s Veil between core items to prepare for Malphite’s targeted ability when Kennen engages.

Olaf.teamfight: Go in when allies have caught an enemy or you can hit several enemies from out of vision. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, your stun won’t work on him, so create distance and wait it out, then complete your marks after it ends.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, but Kennen can hold his ground without getting close by using his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to poke. Olaf is relatively weaker late, but Kennen is also fragile, so prioritize survival to get one good engage.
Olaf.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so build some health too. Effects that reduce attack speed are also useful against an opponent whose damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Apply the second mark with an empowered basic attack from Kennen W Electrical Surge, then use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun. Before applying the second mark, make sure you can follow up with Kennen W Electrical Surge.
Olaf.escape: If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to create distance. Don’t keep taking Olaf’s basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing and extend its duration.
Olaf.fight: Use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and briefly trade by completing three marks when Olaf steps up to last-hit. You can fight again when Olaf R Ragnarok has ended and he hasn’t picked up the Olaf Q Undertow axe.
Olaf.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken won’t reach Olaf when he is standing behind minions, so poke from an angle where it can hit. Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor, so move away from where the axe lands. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun doesn’t work, so create distance and stun him after Olaf R Ragnarok ends. When low on health, also watch out for Olaf E Reckless Swing, which armor can’t reduce.

Singed.watch: Following Singed Q Poison Trail means continuously taking poison damage, so don’t chase even if he looks low unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure. You can’t escape Singed W Mega Adhesive with Kennen E Lightning Rush, and Singed E Fling roots you if it hits while you’re on it, so go around the adhesive. If Singed is standing with his back to his allies, position yourself so Singed E Fling can’t throw you into their team.
Singed.teamfight: Don’t commit multiple players to Singed or follow Singed Q Poison Trail. Attack Singed’s allies while holding Singed with Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun. When enemies are grouped and either an ally has caught them first or you can flank, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to set up an area stun. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, do so when your allies can follow immediately; otherwise, save it to escape.
Singed.build: Singed’s main damage is magic, and Kennen has low magic resistance, so build a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand it. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and fit Banshee’s Veil between core items since the enemy’s damage is heavily magic.
Singed.combo: For a basic trade, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with an empowered basic attack ready from Kennen W Electrical Surge, then use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and stun. Before applying the second mark, check whether you can follow through with the third. When engaging in a team fight, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Singed.escape: After you’ve gone around Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling is down, you have a chance to engage. Singed has no skill to create distance on his own, so complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun to catch him. If you used Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no way out, so decide before engaging whether to save Kennen E Lightning Rush for an escape.
Singed.fight: Early on, use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. When Singed, marked twice, steps up to last-hit, complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun with a basic attack and Kennen W Electrical Surge. Don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage if you could step onto Singed W Mega Adhesive or get hit by Singed E Fling.
Singed.laning: If Singed is behind minions, Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken can’t reach him, so poke from a position where you can hit. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes difficult to catch after completing his core items, and Kennen has low health in the late game, so choose your engage carefully.

Trundle.escape: After Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, use the opening when he has no way to block your escape route to look for an engage. Trundle has no skill to create distance on his own, so you can hold him with a Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun. If you used Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no escape, so go in when your allies can follow immediately.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Choosing an attack-speed slow can also help you take fewer hits from Trundle. Trundle R Subjugate reduces resistances and deals damage based on maximum health, so getting out of range comes first instead of just stacking more resistances or health.
Trundle.combo: When applying the second mark, check whether you still have a way to follow up with the third. If you have an opening to engage multiple enemies in a team fight, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Trundle.fight: Don’t continue fighting on Trundle W Frozen Domain, and create distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active. Decide first whether to use Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape or engage.
Trundle.laning: Use your range to poke nearby Trundle with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but look for a clear shot because minions block Q. Trundle heals whenever a nearby enemy unit dies through Trundle P King’s Tribute, so don’t stay in a prolonged sustain fight after lowering his health; take your advantage or push the wave to force him to recall. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Trundle.teamfight: Look for an opening while avoiding areas covered by Trundle W Frozen Domain and narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape. When an ally has caught an enemy or you can flank multiple enemies from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to apply area marks and stun.
Trundle.watch: Trundle gains attack speed, movement speed, and healing while on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so leave the area and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape route and slows you, so avoid narrow paths and move to the side as soon as the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tougher, so create distance.

Gnar.teamfight: Avoid fighting with a wall behind you or in narrow terrain because of Gnar R GNAR! Just after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar, when your allies have locked down enemies or you can flank from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to stack marks on multiple enemies. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, your allies must be able to follow immediately.
Gnar.combo: First check whether Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered attack is ready. Stack three marks with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken → empowered attack → Kennen W Electrical Surge to trigger Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun.
Gnar.escape: The moment after baiting out Gnar E Hop / Crunch is your window to close the distance. Look to engage if Mega Gnar’s crowd control is down or just after he turns back into Mini Gnar. Keep in mind that using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage leaves you without an escape.
Gnar.fight: Watch Gnar’s rage bar and look for an opening just after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar. If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, mark him with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, then stun him with Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered attack followed by its active.
Gnar.laning: Mini Gnar pokes from range, but take advantage of his low health and trade after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down. Start the trade with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. It is blocked by minions, so wait for a clear angle against Gnar when he is behind them. If you push the wave, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Gnar.phase: Early on, endure Mini Gnar’s ranged poke and take advantage of his low health and look for an opening when Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down. Later, Kennen is fragile, so wait for a safe engage angle.
Gnar.watch: Dodge the path of Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss so Gnar cannot catch the boomerang. Back away when Mega Gnar approaches, and avoid standing with a wall behind you so Gnar R GNAR! cannot stun you by knocking you into one.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, Gnar E Hop / Crunch, and Gnar R GNAR!, which deal most of his damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing items that only greatly increase health.

Mordekaiser.escape: The window to engage is after Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp is down, but if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter his range alone. Mordekaiser has no mobility spell, so he has trouble escaping once caught. If you used Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no way out, so go in when allies can follow immediately.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren’t caught by Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, and don’t stand alone within range when Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready. When allies have caught an enemy or you can hit several enemies from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to aim for a multi-target stun.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp pulls you in, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise can follow, so keep your distance and avoid facing him head-on. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade only once or twice before backing off. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, you can’t count on help from allies, so don’t enter his range alone.
Mordekaiser.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Mordekaiser’s main damage is magic, and Kennen has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If most of the enemy team’s damage is magic, fit Banshee’s Veil between core items.
Mordekaiser.combo: Don’t start this sequence if minions are blocking Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. When you have an angle to reach several enemies, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, then follow with Kennen W Electrical Surge and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Mordekaiser.fight: Right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible activates its shield, don’t dump your damage into it. Focus him after the shield is worn down or converted into healing. If Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, don’t stay close; create distance.
Mordekaiser.laning: If Mordekaiser is behind minions, Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken can’t reach him, so poke from an angle where it can hit. When applying two marks, make sure you have a way to follow up with the third right away. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Mordekaiser.phase: Kennen peaks in the mid game once he has his engage item and ability power. In the late game, Kennen has very low health, so stay alive and wait for a good engage instead of forcing the first engage.

Ornn.laning: Use your range to poke melee opponent Ornn with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, while accounting for the fact that the shuriken won’t reach Ornn behind minions. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, approach and attack to interrupt him. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Ornn.build: Build your engage item and ability power for the mid game. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance. If crowd control often leaves you trapped and killed, prioritize tenacity over resistance.
Ornn.combo: The basic trade sequence is to apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive, and the third by casting Kennen W Electrical Surge. Complete the final mark and stun Ornn when he steps up to last-hit; don’t waste the marks by stacking all three in advance. In a teamfight, when you have an angle to reach several enemies, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken in that order.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so engage during the window when both movement tools are down. Conversely, if Ornn still has crowd control, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage. Don’t retreat toward the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or a wall; move into open space.
Ornn.fight: Managing distance comes first, so don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to poke while Ornn E Searing Charge is available. The window to engage is when both Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down.
Ornn.phase: Early on, Ornn’s damage is low and Kennen can poke melee opponents with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, so take the lead in lane. In the late game, Kennen’s low health makes engaging dangerous, so use your early advantage to pressure Ornn before his items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.teamfight: When an ally has caught an enemy first or you can enter from the flank and out of vision, find an angle where Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can reach several enemies. Move out of the line between the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn before engaging.
Ornn.watch: If you are slowed by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and stand near the pillar, Ornn E Searing Charge can follow with a knock-up. Move away from the pillar and walls into open space. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, don’t move forward; keep your distance. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God begins, dodge the spirit to the side and leave the line between it and Ornn.

Skarner.laning: Use your range to poke melee opponent Skarner with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but remember Q can’t reach him when he’s behind minions. Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered basic attack can clear the wave, but if you push, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks. Manage your distance in open areas so Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact doesn’t knock you into a wall.
Skarner.teamfight: Watch for the threat of Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and Skarner R Impale, and activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when an ally has caught an enemy first or you can flank from out of vision. If possible, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape after the area stun. If you engage with E, do so only when your allies can follow immediately. Don’t stand by the edge of the Dragon or Baron pit, since Skarner R Impale can drag you inside.
Skarner.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first based on Skarner’s main damage, but it won’t block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.combo: For a basic trade, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with a basic attack ready from Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive, then use W to apply the third. Before applying the second mark, check whether you can immediately complete the stun with W. When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down and you have an opening to engage in a team fight, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Skarner.escape: Right after you bait Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, you have a chance to close the distance or pick Skarner off. Before then, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape and don’t enter the short range of Skarner R Impale first. If you’re already suppressed by R, a movement ability can’t free you, so judge the suppression risk and whether you have a cleansing item before going in.
Skarner.fight: Poke from a distance with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, then look to trade right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down. After stacking two marks, when Skarner steps forward, complete three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm with an empowered basic attack and Kennen W Electrical Surge to stun him. Don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage while Skarner still has a way to catch you.
Skarner.phase: Mid game is Kennen’s peak, when engage items and ability power come together, so look for an opening while Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down. In the late game, account for Kennen’s low health and Skarner’s increased damage from tank items, and avoid engaging head-on. Gain early objective control with your team to delay Skarner’s item timings.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain and stuns you if it catches you and you hit a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. After Skarner R Impale suppresses you, Kennen E Lightning Rush can’t get you out, so check your distance before entering its short range. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval’s empowered basic attack is dangerous when you’re close, so stay outside melee range.

Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to kill Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle; target a vulnerable enemy behind him. If your allies can’t follow immediately, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to get out.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types, so armor alone won’t block all his damage. Both abilities deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Udyr.combo: A basic trade goes in this order: apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with an empowered basic attack from Kennen W Electrical Surge, and the third by activating Kennen W Electrical Surge. Complete the stun after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowerment ends. If you have an angle to enter among several enemies and your allies can follow immediately, brush past them with Kennen E Lightning Rush, then use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken in that order.
Udyr.escape: The moment after Udyr uses E Blazing Stampede is your chance to manage distance or attack. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, you can retaliate or escape with Kennen E Lightning Rush while Udyr can’t immediately stun you again. Don’t go for a stun while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered; apply Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun after it ends.
Udyr.fight: Poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken before Udyr gets close, and save Kennen E Lightning Rush for when he approaches. When the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle wears off, attack without giving him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: Use your range to lower Udyr’s health with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken before he can approach. Q won’t reach Udyr if he’s behind minions, so use it from an angle where it can hit. If you push the lane, get vision at the river and jungle entrances, and don’t move forward when Udyr is out of sight.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Kennen can gain an advantage over close-range Udyr with his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke. Late game, Kennen has to engage with little health, so stay alive while waiting for an angle to hit several enemies with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes distance quickly and stuns, so keep your distance right after he activates it. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun won’t work, so complete the marks after the empowerment ends. If Udyr gets close, watch out for basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw and the slow from Udyr R Wingborne Storm.

Aatrox.combo: Apply the final mark when Aatrox steps forward to last-hit or just after he uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash. If Kennen W Electrical Surge's empowered attack isn't ready, don't use its active effect first.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance. If the duel is likely to drag on, build resistances, then get Grievous Wounds.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after baiting out Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to close the gap. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is down too, decide whether to use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage. If Infernal Chains catches you, prioritize using Kennen E Lightning Rush to leave its area rather than to engage.
Aatrox.fight: Look to trade just after Aatrox uses the empowered attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, don't fight him; wait for its duration to end.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken's range, but remember that it can't hit Aatrox when he's standing behind minions. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks. Focus on farming without giving Aatrox an early kill.
Aatrox.phase: Early on, Kennen can poke melee opponents with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but prioritize spacing and farming because giving Aatrox a kill puts you at a disadvantage. Kennen is fragile later, so wait for a safe opening to engage.
Aatrox.teamfight: Look for an angle where Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can hit several enemies when your team has already caught someone or you can flank from out of vision. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, then Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your team can follow right away. If your team can't join immediately, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous if its edge hits you, so watch the cast animation and dodge outside its outer edge or inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately. Use Kennen E Lightning Rush if you risk being pulled back in.

DrMundo.laning: Early on, use Dr. Mundo's low magic resistance to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but keep a minion between you and him to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. After trading, back up while stepping on the canister Dr. Mundo drops to deny both its healing and the reduction to his passive's cooldown. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
DrMundo.escape: Dodge Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and look to engage after Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. Dr. Mundo has no spell to create distance on his own, but engaging with Kennen E Lightning Rush leaves you without an escape, so go in only when your team can follow immediately.
DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo's main damage, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, is physical, so build armor first. If you expect a long duel, build resistances, then get Grievous Wounds to counter Dr. Mundo's healing.
DrMundo.combo: The basic sequence is Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken → Kennen W Electrical Surge's empowered basic attack → use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply three marks. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first stun, so use that stun to remove his passive, then look to engage with the repeated marks from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom. In teamfights, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
DrMundo.fight: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, account for it ignoring your first stun, and wait until the passive is down before fully engaging. Don't insist on a takedown while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.phase: Early on, Kennen should use Dr. Mundo's low magic resistance to secure an advantage through poke. Later, choose your engage carefully, accounting for Kennen's low health and Dr. Mundo's increased magic resistance.
DrMundo.teamfight: If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, look for a group of other enemies rather than spending time trying to kill Dr. Mundo. When your team has caught an enemy or you can flank from out of vision, activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to stack marks across the enemy team.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw slows the first target it hits and heals Dr. Mundo, so dodge it with minions between you. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don't engage with a stun from Kennen P Mark of the Storm while his passive is available. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don't spend time trying to kill him.

Aurora.teamfight: When your team has caught someone or you can flank several enemies from out of vision, activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom and look for an area stun. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, go in only when your team can follow immediately; save it for after Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom if you need to escape. If an ally is taken down, Aurora W Across the Veil's cooldown may reset, so don't leave a low-health ally behind when you retreat.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, don't waste your spells; wait for her to reappear. When you have an angle to hit several enemies, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and immediately use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, then Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Aurora.escape: You have an opening to engage if Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down and Aurora R Between Worlds isn't available yet. If only one mobility spell is down, wait, since she can escape with the remaining spell. In teamfights, you get an opening to catch Aurora after she dives in if no one has been taken down.
Aurora.fight: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you while you're missing health, don't extend the trade; retreat before it recalls. If Aurora has used only one mobility spell, hold your engage with her remaining mobility in mind.
Aurora.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first enemy it strikes, so don't throw it at Aurora when she's behind minions. You can clear the wave with Kennen W Electrical Surge's empowered attack without using a spell. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Aurora.phase: Early on, poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but watch out for the recall damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex. Kennen is fragile later, so survive until you find an opening to engage.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases the more health you've lost. If you're cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself; if you're low on health, retreat before the recall. After Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, leaving its area slows you, so decide whether to retreat before it appears.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so Kennen should build magic resistance first. In the early game, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Slot Banshee’s Veil between core items to block the first ability that hits when you engage.

Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t bunch up around him. Avoid the stun, then focus your crowd control on him. Kennen should engage and apply marks to multiple enemies with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when allies have caught an enemy or you can reach several enemies from out of vision. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, allies must be able to follow immediately. Save it to disengage if you may need to get out.
Jax.build: Jax deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so avoid prioritizing resistance to only one type. Basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so consider items that reduce attack speed first. Also avoid stacking health alone, since Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Don’t start this sequence while Counter Strike is active, since it negates basic attacks.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your window to close the gap or catch him out. Go in only after the stun from Jax E Counter Strike has also ended. While Counter Strike is active, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to move out of stun range.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and create distance, then trade again once it ends. Don’t stay in a prolonged fight and let Jax P Relentless Assault stack attack speed.
Jax.laning: Don’t stand close to a minion wave that Jax can use as a springboard for Jax Q Leap Strike. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Jax.phase: Kennen peaks in the mid game once he has his engage item and ability power. In the late game, he is fragile, so choose your engage carefully.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, your basic attacks and their applied marks are negated, and its recast damage and stun are dangerous. Stop basic attacking and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to move out of stun range. Jax Q Leap Strike can use minions or wards as a springboard, so be careful not to misjudge your distance near them.

Pantheon.teamfight: Use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to look for an AoE stun when an ally has caught an enemy or you can flank several enemies from out of vision. If Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, watch your approach distance, and don’t focus damage into the front of Pantheon E Aegis Assault. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, go in when your allies can follow immediately; if you need to escape, save it for after Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Kennen can make the most of his strengths in mid game when he has both an engage item and ability power.
Pantheon.combo: For a standard trade, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive, then the third with Kennen W Electrical Surge to stun. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking you from the front, wait for it to end or start the sequence from the side. When engaging multiple enemies, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Pantheon.escape: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, you have a chance to approach without being stunned. Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also a mobility tool, so don’t force an engage just because Pantheon W Shield Vault is down; look for an opening before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no way out, so only go in if you’ve considered how you’ll escape.
Pantheon.fight: Once you have two Mark of the Storm stacks, stun Pantheon with an empowered basic attack and Kennen W Electrical Surge when he steps up to last-hit. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and deal damage after it ends.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke, but use Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from an angle that hits Pantheon directly, since minions block it. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks. If you avoid giving up kills early and buy time, Pantheon’s influence will fade.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence wanes in the late game, but Kennen is also fragile, so look for a safe engage angle.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so stay out of its range. Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t attack from the front; wait for it to end or approach from the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Volibear.escape: The moment after you avoid Volibear Q Thundering Smash is your window to use Kennen’s range advantage. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t go deep just because Q is down; look for an opening before R comes off cooldown. When Volibear chases with Q Thundering Smash, don’t run straight away; use Kennen E Lightning Rush to create distance or move toward your allies.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear is stacking Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions or monsters, avoid fighting him while it’s stacked and wait until the stacks fall off. When an ally has locked down an enemy or you can enter from the side, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to build marks on several enemies and look for an AoE stun. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, make sure your allies can follow immediately; otherwise, save E to get out.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, get an item that reduces healing. If you have to endure many basic attacks, consider an option that lowers attack speed. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on maximum health, so be wary of stacking a lot of health alone.
Volibear.combo: When Volibear can approach with Q Thundering Smash, save a way to apply the third mark and use it to interrupt his engage. In a teamfight where you can enter among several enemies, brush past them with Kennen E Lightning Rush, then use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, W, and Q in that order.
Volibear.fight: While Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, poke from outside his range with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Avoid long trades that let Volibear heal with W Frenzied Maul, and only commit further when you can finish him.
Volibear.laning: Poke nearby Volibear with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but find an angle to hit from, since Q won’t reach him if he’s behind minions. Bait out Volibear Q Thundering Smash, then poke and take lane control. If you push the lane, get river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Volibear.phase: Early on, Kennen can poke Volibear with his range, especially while Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down. Late game, Kennen’s low health means you must choose your engage carefully.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear activates Volibear Q Thundering Smash and charges at you, stay outside his empowered attack range to avoid the stun. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move sideways to avoid its damage and slow, and watch where Volibear is trying to gain the shield. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret just because your health is low; retreat farther in and use Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape the landing point.

Darius.teamfight: Look for an area stun with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when your team has caught an enemy or you can flank several enemies from out of vision. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, then follow with Kennen W Electrical Surge and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your team can follow right away. Don't stay within Darius R Noxian Guillotine range with several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage.
Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Darius E Apprehend partially ignores resistances, and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so your total health also matters when trying to survive his ultimate.
Darius.combo: Apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken while Darius E Apprehend is down.
Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Kennen E Lightning Rush is your only escape, so if you use it to engage, first consider whether you can avoid a long fight that lets Darius P Hemorrhage stack up.
Darius.fight: Trade briefly when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Apply a mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, complete the stun with an empowered basic attack and Kennen W Electrical Surge, then create distance before Darius P Hemorrhage stacks up.
Darius.laning: Use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from outside Darius E Apprehend range. Look for the moment just after Darius uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Darius.phase: Early on, Kennen can use his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to poke melee opponents, but avoid extended fights with Darius and early skirmishes. Kennen is very fragile later, so focus on surviving while waiting for an opening to engage.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. Create distance to drop the stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage, and if you're low with several stacks of Hemorrhage, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

KSante.escape: Do not engage just because K'Sante W Path Maker or E Footwork is down. Look for a window when his mobility and crowd control are down and R All Out has not returned yet. Using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage leaves you without an escape, so go in when your allies can follow immediately.
KSante.build: Kennen’s magic damage is effective against K'Sante, who has relatively low magic resistance, so build the items and ability power you need to engage in mid game. Armor helps against the physical damage from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct, Q Ntofo Strikes, and W Path Maker. However, account for the penetration from K'Sante R All Out and the true damage from W Path Maker. If you are often caught by chained crowd control, you can prioritize tenacity over resistance.
KSante.combo: The basic trade is Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken for the first mark, Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered attack for the second, then W for the third mark and Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun. While K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, he is unstoppable and has damage reduction, so do not commit your stun combo; dodge the charge to the side. If you have an angle to engage on multiple enemies, brush past them with Kennen E Lightning Rush and follow with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, W, then Q.
KSante.fight: Early on, keep your distance and poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, stacking up to two marks. When K'Sante steps up to last-hit and you can apply the third mark, complete the stun with an empowered attack and Kennen W Electrical Surge. When K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your damage while he is vulnerable, but do not take on K'Sante alone when his damage and healing are also stronger.
KSante.laning: Q cannot reach K'Sante behind minions, so poke from an angle where it can hit. If you push the wave, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
KSante.phase: Later, Kennen is very fragile, so choose your engage angle carefully to avoid getting caught by K'Sante’s chained crowd control.
KSante.teamfight: Activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when your allies have locked enemies down first or you can flank multiple enemies from out of vision. While K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your damage on him with your allies. If the fight may last a long time, it is best for at least one person on your team to have a way to reduce healing.
KSante.watch: If you have been hit by K’Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession or his stacks are full, retreat out of range to avoid the pull and stun from his next Q. When you see K’Sante W Path Maker charging, step to the side of his charge direction instead of fishing for a Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun or committing your damage. When facing him, don’t stand with a wall behind you, so K’Sante R All Out can’t knock you over it.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Don’t invest in magic resistance just to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Apply the first Mark of the Storm stack with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken and the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive. When Poppy steps up to last-hit, use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and complete the Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun. Before applying the second mark, make sure Kennen W Electrical Surge will be available to follow up.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your window to close the distance. Wait for the short duration of Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end, and account for the risk of being knocked away by Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict before engaging. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no way out, so only go in if you’ve considered how you’ll escape afterward.
Poppy.fight: Don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage carelessly before Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, her movement speed and defenses are increased, so wait until it ends before fighting.
Poppy.laning: Minions block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, so poke from an angle that reaches Poppy. Avoid standing with your back to walls or narrow passages; stay in open space to avoid being stunned by Poppy E Heroic Charge. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Poppy.phase: Mid game is Kennen’s peak, so take advantage of Poppy E Heroic Charge being down. Kennen has low health in the late game, so wait for a safe angle before committing to an engage.
Poppy.teamfight: If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, clip at least one enemy, then immediately use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, in that order. You can also save Kennen E Lightning Rush for your escape; if you use it to engage, do so when your allies can follow immediately.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you once, leave the remaining zone immediately. When Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its direct line.

TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, it’s harder for him to engage or escape, giving Kennen a chance to fight. Back off first if Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked or you’re in range of Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash. Using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage leaves you without an escape, so check that your allies can follow immediately.
TahmKench.phase: Early on, Kennen can poke melee opponents with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but prioritize keeping your distance so Tahm Kench can’t catch you. In the late game, Kennen has very low health, so create a safe engage angle from out of vision.
TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench’s main damage is magic, and Kennen has relatively low magic resistance, so build a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand it. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and fit Banshee’s Veil between core items. If prolonged fights make the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin a problem, build Morellonomicon earlier.
TahmKench.combo: The basic sequence is Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken for the first mark, an empowered basic attack ready from Kennen W Electrical Surge for the second, then Kennen W Electrical Surge for the third mark and stun. Before applying the second mark, check whether you can immediately follow up with the third.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into a shield or healing, so don’t stay in drawn-out trades where you deal damage in small amounts. Stack Kennen P Mark of the Storm twice, then apply the stun and damage together once you have a way to apply the third mark. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked, create distance first.
TahmKench.laning: Use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but line up a clear shot because minions block it against Tahm Kench. When Tahm Kench steps forward to last-hit, apply the third mark with a ready basic attack and Kennen W Electrical Surge. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
TahmKench.teamfight: When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive’s animation, spread out from allies to avoid multiple people being knocked up. When an ally has caught an enemy first or you can flank, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and follow with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, he can save the enemy he’s protecting, so pressure them with area damage instead of focusing on the swallowed target.
TahmKench.watch: If you think Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to disappear. Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can lead to a slow and stun, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive knocks up in an area, so spread out from allies when you see him dive.

Camille.escape: The window after Camille E Hookshot's stun and dash are down is a good time for Kennen to engage. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is down too, she has fewer ways to re-engage, so look for that opening. When engaging with Kennen E Lightning Rush, make sure your team can follow immediately, since you'll have no way out.
Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille's main damage. Armor can't reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking large amounts of health alone.
Camille.combo: Apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken and the second with Kennen W Electrical Surge's empowered basic attack, then use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and stun. Apply the final mark when Camille steps forward to last-hit, and delay the trade if the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses is active.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates.
Camille.laning: Stay between minions and away from walls, and poke from an angle where minions won't block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Take lane control before Camille completes her first core item, but if you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage.
Camille.phase: Early on, use Kennen's range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to take control and pressure Camille's farming before her first core item. Later, choose your engage carefully because Kennen is fragile, and don't leave a side lane open because Camille can quickly take down turrets there.
Camille.teamfight: Look for an area stun with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when you can hit several enemies and either your team has caught an enemy or you can flank from out of vision. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, then use Kennen W Electrical Surge and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your team can follow. If you have an angle that lets you save Kennen E Lightning Rush, use it to escape after landing the area stun.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses a wall to dash in and stun, so stand away from walls. When the hook starts, use Kennen E Lightning Rush's movement speed to create distance. Crowd control doesn't affect Camille during the initial engage of Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, so don't waste your stun then.

Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility spell, so dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast and look for a chance to catch her when Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed boost is down. If you complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun first, you can follow up with damage before Kayle escapes with Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If you used Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no escape, so go in only when allies can follow immediately.
Kayle.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Kayle’s damage is mainly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Avoid Kayle Q Radiant Blast to make that resistance count. Against her magic damage, fit Banshee’s Veil between core items.
Kayle.combo: Delay your combo if Kayle is behind minions that can block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, or if you can’t follow up with the third mark.
Kayle.fight: Once Kayle has used Kayle R Divine Judgment, it’s a good time to start a full fight.
Kayle.laning: Take lane control early and keep denying Kayle CS and experience. Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first enemy it reaches, so don’t throw it at Kayle when she is standing behind minions. If you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Kayle.teamfight: Instead of facing the frontline head-on, find a path from the flank and out of vision to reach Kayle in the back, and engage when your allies’ crowd control lands as well. If you go in with Kennen E Lightning Rush, brush past enemies as you engage, then use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken in that order. Allies must be able to follow immediately.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers Kennen’s resistances and slows him, so avoid taking a direct hit. When low on health, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on missing health. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t dump your damage into her. Lock her down with Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun and wait out the invulnerability.

Quinn.build: Quinn’s main damage is physical, so prioritize items with armor. You don’t need to build magic resistance against her damage.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage. Don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush prematurely; if you engage, use it along a path that hits Quinn to restore energy.
Quinn.fight: Farm or start trades when Quinn P Harrier is not marking you.
Quinn.laning: Avoid Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind minions and look for an angle to hit with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush for ganks.
Quinn.phase: Early on, avoid Quinn P Harrier marks while poking with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Make use of Kennen’s strong mid-game engages, and choose your angles carefully in the late game given your low health.
Quinn.teamfight: When an ally has caught an enemy or you have a flank angle, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and look for an AoE stun with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, then Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, your allies need to be able to follow immediately.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move beyond basic attack range to avoid her empowered attack. Stand behind minions to block Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don’t throw Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken while your vision is reduced. Quinn E Vault knocks Kennen back and slows him, so don’t force an approach before it is down.

Yasuo.teamfight: If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, make sure your allies can follow immediately; save it if you need it to escape. Create an angle before engaging so you don’t walk in from the front and get caught by the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Keep in mind that armor won’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: A basic trade goes in this order: apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, trigger the empowered basic attack from Kennen W Electrical Surge with a basic attack, then activate Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and complete the stun. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is active, find a new angle to throw the shuriken or wait for the wall to disappear.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, his stacks for a knock-up reset, so look to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a short-cooldown movement ability, so don’t go deep just because he used it once. Start the fight when you can complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before starting a trade. Dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or acting right after Yasuo throws it is your chance to fight aggressively.
Yasuo.laning: Early on, use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and keep in mind that the shuriken won’t reach Yasuo if he’s behind minions. Keeping the wave pushing slowly toward your side can reduce the stepping stones available for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If you push the lane, get river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Kennen is good at poking close-range opponents, but you need to manage your distance to stop Yasuo E Sweeping Blade from closing in. Late game, Kennen has very little health, so stay alive while waiting for an engage angle.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to approach, so don’t give him space where there are many minions. After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, he can knock you up with the tornado and follow with Yasuo R Last Breath, so watch the effect and move sideways out of its line. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, find an angle around it before using Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken or wait for it to disappear.

Kled.laning: Keep your distance against melee Kled and poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Q won’t reach Kled behind minions, so find an angle where it can hit. After dismounting Kled, create distance if you can’t finish him for certain, and push Kled away from the lane so he can’t build Courage by killing minions.
Kled.build: Prioritize armor to counter Kled’s main damage. Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Kled.combo: Apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, then apply the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive. Before applying the second mark, make sure you can cast W right away.
Kled.escape: Avoid the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, then look to engage after Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down. If only Kled E Jousting is down, he can still close the gap again with R, so don’t rush to use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage.
Kled.fight: If Kled still has a way to catch you, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage.
Kled.phase: Early on, Kennen can poke Kled when he gets close with his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but prioritize keeping your distance so you aren’t caught. In the late game, choose your engages carefully because Kennen has low health. You’ll be better off the longer the game goes without giving Kled an early lead.
Kled.teamfight: Watch the flank, since Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from out of vision, and keep your team formation with an allied tank in front. When allies have caught an enemy or you can reach clustered enemies from the flank, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and immediately use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken in that order. If you use E to engage, make sure allies can follow immediately.
Kled.watch: If you are caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to create distance before it pulls you in. Kled can close the gap again with Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, so don’t stay close enough to take all four empowered attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies.

Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow paths, and check your engage route. When enemies are grouped and either an ally has caught them or you can flank, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to apply area marks and stun. If your allies can’t follow immediately, save Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape.
Teemo.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Teemo’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, and fit Banshee’s Veil between core items to block one targeted ability that hits you as you engage.
Teemo.combo: Don’t try an empowered basic attack while blinded; use a skill or back off until the blind ends. When engaging multiple enemies in a team fight, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Teemo.escape: After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down and Teemo has used Teemo W Move Quick, you have a chance to close the distance. Teemo has no way to escape besides Teemo W Move Quick, so if you go in with Kennen E Lightning Rush, aim to pass by Teemo, apply a mark, and get your energy back.
Teemo.fight: Look to trade with basic attacks after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. A short trade followed by backing off often loses out to the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot, so if you commit, aim to chain three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm and stun him. Using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage leaves you without an escape, so check for an opening first.
Teemo.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken can’t reach Teemo behind minions, so poke from a position where you can apply a mark. If you push the wave with Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered basic attack, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks. Don’t simply walk past brush without vision; use a Control Ward or go around it.
Teemo.phase: Early on, avoid short trades where you take Teemo’s basic attack and poison before backing off, and build magic resistance. In the late game, Kennen has low health, so focus on staying alive and finding one good engage angle.
Teemo.watch: If you’re hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, your basic attacks are negated, so stop auto-attacking while blinded and use a skill such as Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken or retreat. Teemo E Toxic Shot keeps dealing poison damage after just one basic attack, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to commit. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in brush without vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap in chokepoints.

Chogath.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes, and fit Banshee's Veil between core items. Resistance can't block the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.combo: Apply the final mark when Cho'Gath steps up to last-hit, and don't waste a stun by stacking three marks in advance.
Chogath.escape: Dodge sideways when you see the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, and save Kennen E Lightning Rush for when you need it. Once Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream are down, you have an opening to engage, and Cho'Gath has no mobility spell to create distance. Account for the fact that you can't use Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape after engaging with it.
Chogath.fight: Look to engage after Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream are down. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no way out, so first make sure you can keep fighting.
Chogath.laning: Stand away from the line Cho'Gath's basic attacks travel along and from behind minions to avoid poke that pierces from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Land Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from an angle where minions won't block it first. Use your early range advantage to pressure him, but if you push the lane, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Chogath.phase: Early on, Kennen can pressure Cho'Gath with his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, leaving him little room to stack. Cho'Gath gets stronger over time, so later don't stay within Cho'Gath R Feast range when your health is precarious.
Chogath.teamfight: Look for an area stun with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom when your team has caught someone or you can flank several enemies from out of vision. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, brush past the enemies and use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your team can follow immediately.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you up after a warning appears underfoot, so move sideways as soon as you see it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, you can't escape with Kennen E Lightning Rush, so avoid facing him head-on. If you're at half health or below, move out of range of the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.

Gangplank.build: Build armor early in lane against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Resistance cannot stop the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so rely on total health to withstand it. If the fight goes long, get Executioner's Calling or Morellonomicon to counter Gangplank W Remove Scurvy.
Gangplank.combo: When applying the second mark, check whether you can apply the third right away.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no skill to create distance, so engage just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or a barrel is destroyed. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is also down, he cannot cleanse the stun from Kennen P Mark of the Storm. Keep in mind that using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage spends your only escape.
Gangplank.fight: The moment after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before the barrel is primed, is your trade window. Back away if there is a primed barrel nearby.
Gangplank.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first enemy it reaches, so it cannot reach Gangplank when he stands behind minions. You can clear the wave with Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered attack, but if you push, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks. Near a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg, prioritize keeping your distance over going for last hits.
Gangplank.phase: Mid game, when you have your engage items and ability power, is Kennen’s peak, so actively look for opportunities to fight then. Later, Kennen is very fragile, so focus on staying alive until the moment to engage.
Gangplank.teamfight: When the enemy team is grouped and either your allies have locked them down first or you can flank from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, brush past enemies and immediately use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Your allies must be able to follow immediately if you have used all of Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage. Also check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used when choosing when to fight for an objective.
Gangplank.watch: If a Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, move out of its blast radius, and stay off spots where two barrels overlap. If you destroy a barrel from outside its blast radius, it disappears without exploding.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Resistance cannot reduce Garen R Demacian Justice, so consider your total health when deciding whether you can survive it.
Garen.combo: The basic sequence is Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken for the first mark, Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered attack for the second, then Kennen W Electrical Surge’s active for the third. When Garen W Courage grants its shield and tenacity, wait briefly instead of completing the stun. Start the combo when you can apply the third mark before the marks expire.
Garen.escape: Garen has no skill to create distance, so the moment after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack has been used is your chance to engage. Using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage leaves you without an escape, so save it if you could get caught alone. When Garen E Judgment starts, avoid staying close and use Kennen E Lightning Rush to get out of its range.
Garen.fight: Take a short trade just after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used on a minion or has been expended. When Garen activates Garen W Courage, delay your combo by half a beat to avoid the brief moment when he gains a shield and tenacity.
Garen.laning: Early on, use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken and keep up the pressure so Garen has no room to build up. Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken cannot reach Garen behind minions, so find an angle to land it. If you push the wave, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Garen.phase: Early on, use Kennen’s range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to pressure Garen. Garen grows stronger over time as the strength he builds with Garen W Courage remains, so avoid reckless engages later and choose your engage carefully.
Garen.teamfight: When the enemy team is grouped and either your allies have locked them down first or you can flank from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to look for an AoE stun. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, follow with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your allies can follow immediately.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack silences you and prevents you from retaliating, so keep your distance while he has it ready. Garen E Judgment deals more damage the longer he stays on you, so use Kennen E Lightning Rush to get out of its range. If your health is below half, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.

Gwen.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Gwen’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first, and fit Banshee's Veil between your core items. The true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! cannot be blocked by resistance, so you also need to manage your distance.
Gwen.combo: If Gwen W Hallowed Mist prevents you from following up, do not rush to apply the second mark. When engaging in a team fight, brush past enemies with Kennen E Lightning Rush and use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, then Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Gwen.escape: If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you will have no escape, so go in only when you can follow up with more attacks.
Gwen.fight: Early on, poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken before Gwen builds stacks of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and stay outside her basic attack range. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist ends and Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, you have a chance to close the distance and fight.
Gwen.laning: Use your range advantage to poke melee Gwen with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but find an angle because Q cannot reach her when she is behind minions. If you let Gwen keep basic attacking you, she can heal, so keep your distance after poking. If you push the wave, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Gwen.phase: Early on, Kennen is good at poking melee opponents, and the time to trade with Gwen is before she stacks Gwen Q Snip Snip!. Later, Kennen is very fragile, so stay alive until an engage angle appears.
Gwen.teamfight: Watch Gwen W Hallowed Mist’s position.
