When enemies are grouped and either your allies have locked them down first or you can flank from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to look for an AoE stun. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, brush past enemies to restore energy and immediately activate R; also make sure your allies can follow right away. If you can save E for your escape, stun them with R and then get out.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so walk sideways out of it when Gwen closes in. After Gwen E Skip 'n Slash engages, back away to avoid her increased attack range and the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target Gwen from outside the mist, so wait for it to end or look for an angle to enter.

Illaoi.build: Account for Illaoi’s healing and get Executioner's Calling early to reduce it. Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Since W deals damage based on your maximum health, do not stack health alone.
Illaoi.combo: Before applying the second mark, check whether you can apply the third right away. If you get an angle to engage on multiple enemies, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → R Slicing Maelstrom → W Electrical Surge → Q Thundering Shuriken.
Illaoi.escape: The moment after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and make her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is your chance to close the distance. Engaging with Kennen E Lightning Rush leaves you without an escape, so use it to create distance when Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.fight: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and look to trade just after she uses W Harsh Lesson. Kennen E Lightning Rush is your only escape, so when using it to engage, also consider how you will get back out.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken cannot reach Illaoi behind minions, so poke from an angle where it can hit. If you push the wave, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Illaoi.phase: Early on, Kennen can use his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to poke melee Illaoi. Kennen peaks in mid game and is fragile later, so focus on staying alive until an engage angle appears.
Illaoi.teamfight: Avoid areas with Illaoi’s tentacles, and spread out to wait out Illaoi R Leap of Faith. When your allies have locked down an enemy or you can reach multiple enemies from out of vision, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to look for an AoE stun.
Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, its slow and mark put you under pressure, so stay out of range and dodge it near walls with tentacles. If you can fight when your spirit is pulled out, retaliate; if not, break the link and dodge the first tentacle. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, do not group up and back away for its duration.

Irelia.combo: Apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, then the second with an attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge. Follow with Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and complete Kennen P Mark of the Storm’s stun.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance, but Q can reset, so check whether she can dash again immediately. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, decide whether to engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush and keep in mind that this leaves you without an escape.
Irelia.fight: Decide in advance whether to save Kennen E Lightning Rush for your escape against Irelia Q Bladesurge’s chained approaches.
Irelia.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken cannot reach Irelia when she is hidden behind minions, so find an angle and do not leave a low-health minion between you. If you push the wave, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Irelia.phase: Later, Kennen is very fragile, so focus on staying alive until an engage angle appears.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia because Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can dominate a team fight. When your allies have locked her down or you have an angle to reach multiple enemies from out of vision, engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, then follow with Kennen W Electrical Surge and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. If you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, your allies must be able to follow right away.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain onto low-health minions to close in repeatedly, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you are trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jayce.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Jayce’s main damage, but it will not block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast.
Jayce.combo: If Jayce is behind minions, Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken cannot reach him, so find a clear angle first.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is your engage window. It is a good time to close in if Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback has also been used. Keep in mind that engaging with Kennen E Lightning Rush also uses your escape.
Jayce.fight: Against Jayce with the cannon, poke and apply marks with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from an angle where minions will not block it. Close the distance after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, and follow with your stun combo if Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is also down.
Jayce.laning: Jayce is strong early, so move side to side and farm when he has the cannon, and do not force a comeback if you fall behind. If you push the wave with Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered attack, secure river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush against ganks.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm defensively and buy time. Later, you are fragile, so stay alive until an engage angle appears.
Jayce.teamfight: Engage after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down when the enemies are grouped and either your allies have locked them down or you can enter from the side. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately follow with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken to look for an AoE stun. If your allies cannot follow right away, save Kennen E Lightning Rush for your escape.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, move sideways out of the line of fire because Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow. When he holds the hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Renekton.build: Renekton’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. The empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so position to dodge the dash instead of relying only on your armor.
Renekton.combo: Apply the first Mark of the Storm stack with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken and the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive. Then use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third mark and stun. Before applying the second mark, make sure you still have a way to apply the final mark.
Renekton.escape: After Renekton E Slice and Dice and Renekton W Ruthless Predator are down, you have a window to close the distance and attack. If you let him get close before then, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage and move in a direction where Renekton has no target for another dash.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury or right after he has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.laning: Early on, use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken and attack when Renekton steps up to hit minions for Fury. Minions block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, so line up a clear hit, but don’t stand in or behind the minion wave that Renekton E Slice and Dice can use as a stepping stone. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Renekton.phase: If you avoid giving up kills and keep farming, Renekton’s value falls after mid game, but Kennen is fragile in the late game, so choose your engage angles carefully.
Renekton.teamfight: Engage when an ally has caught an enemy or you can flank several enemies from out of vision.
Renekton.watch: If Renekton P Reign of Anger is above half or has enough Fury to reach that threshold with one basic attack, stay out of range to avoid the stun from empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice grants a second dash when it hits a minion, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.

Riven.build: Riven’s damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items up in your build order, and consider getting health so you don’t get finished off by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: Apply the first Mark of the Storm stack to Riven with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, then the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge. Follow with Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third stack and stun her with Kennen P Mark of the Storm. Before applying the second stack, make sure you can follow up with W.
Riven.escape: You have an engage opportunity after Riven Q Broken Wings has been used and before it comes back. Check whether Riven E Valor is still available, since she can use it to escape, and approach when Riven W Ki Burst is down. If you need to back off after seeing Riven’s first dash, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to disengage.
Riven.fight: Normally, keep your distance and poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Punish Riven when she uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, and after she closes in, apply three Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks to stun her and interrupt her follow-up attacks. Before using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, consider whether you’ll be able to escape.
Riven.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken can’t reach Riven when she stands behind minions, so poke from an angle that hits her. Once you have two Mark of the Storm stacks, keep a way to apply the third when Riven steps up to last-hit. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Riven.phase: Early on, pressure melee Riven with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke and look for the long downtime on Riven Q Broken Wings. In the late game, Kennen has low health, so choose your engage angles carefully.
Riven.teamfight: Engage when an ally has caught the enemy, including Riven, or you can catch several enemies from out of vision. If you go in with Kennen E Lightning Rush, clip enemies as you enter, then use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, in that order. If you use E to engage, go in when your allies can follow immediately; if you need to escape, use R while saving E.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings dashes several times and can knock you up; with Riven E Valor afterward, she can close the distance from far away. When you see the first dash, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to create distance and get out before Riven W Ki Burst stuns you. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, range increases and its damage based on your missing health becomes dangerous, so stay back until it ends.

Rumble.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Rumble’s damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Fit Banshee’s Veil between core items to guard against a spell hitting you as you engage.
Rumble.combo: For a standard trade, apply the first Mark of the Storm stack with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive, then apply the third mark and stun with Kennen W Electrical Surge. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait briefly before trading with this sequence. When engaging multiple enemies, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Rumble.escape: If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, don’t stay in place; use Kennen E Lightning Rush to dodge the second shot. Engage after Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield and movement speed boost wear off. Rumble has no mobility spell, so commit when you can complete the Mark of the Storm stun.
Rumble.fight: Keep your distance to reduce how long Rumble Q Flamespitter can hit you, and make Rumble step forward. After his Rumble W Scrap Shield shield expires, trade when he steps up to last-hit by chaining your prepared marks through the third and stunning him. Before using Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, first consider that you’ll have no way to escape afterward.
Rumble.laning: Use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from an angle that minions don’t block. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Rumble.phase: Early on, Kennen has an advantage over melee Rumble with his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke, and Rumble’s low magic resistance also works in your favor. In the late game, Kennen’s health is very low, so avoid forcing the first engage and stay alive until a good angle opens up.
Rumble.teamfight: Use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to look for an AoE stun when an ally has caught an enemy or you can flank a group of enemies from out of vision. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, clip at least one enemy and make sure your allies can follow immediately. If you need an escape route, save Kennen E Lightning Rush and use it to disengage after your ultimate.
Rumble.watch: If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to create distance before the second shot lands. When Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, hold your burst until the shield disappears.

Sett.build: Prioritize armor to reduce damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Lowering attack speed to take fewer basic attacks is also effective. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on maximum health, and Sett W Haymaker’s center deals true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so prioritize movement that avoids the center over stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Before applying the second Mark of the Storm stack, make sure you can follow up with the third.
Sett.escape: While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, Sett has no mobility tool, giving you a window to attack. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, you can engage with less risk of being caught. Account for losing your escape when you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage.
Sett.fight: After dealing damage, briefly back off and watch for Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.laning: When Sett walks toward you, retreat before he gains movement speed and keep your distance. Minions block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, so use it from an angle that reaches Sett. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Sett.phase: Kennen is strongest in mid game and fragile in the late game, so choose your engage angles carefully.
Sett.teamfight: Engage when an ally has caught Sett first or you can reach several enemies from out of vision. If you go in with Kennen E Lightning Rush, immediately activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, then follow with Kennen W Electrical Surge and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. You can also save Kennen E Lightning Rush for your escape; if you use it to engage, your allies need to be able to follow immediately.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker becomes stronger and grants a shield after he has taken a lot of damage, so back off after dealing damage and avoid the center of its aim. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides, so don’t get caught between a minion wave and Sett. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so choose your engage position carefully while Sett has his ultimate.

Shen.build: The time you spend taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: After Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, apply the first Mark of the Storm stack with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, the second with a basic attack empowered by Kennen W Electrical Surge, then use Kennen W Electrical Surge to apply the third stack and stun. While the zone is active, empowered basic attacks are negated, so don’t rush this sequence.
Shen.escape: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, that’s your window to engage and counterattack while his mobility and hard crowd control are down. However, Shen can escape if Shen R Stand United is available, so if you’re aiming for a kill, check whether Shen R Stand United is also down. Also account for having no escape if you use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage.
Shen.fight: Counterattack right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, wait for it to end before continuing the trade with basic attacks.
Shen.laning: Use your range to poke with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but find an angle that hits Shen since the shuriken can’t reach him behind minions. Push the wave to keep Shen occupied clearing minions. After pushing, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Shen.phase: Early on, Kennen can poke melee Shen with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken and take lane control. In the late game, Kennen has low health, so focus on finding a safe engage angle.
Shen.teamfight: Watch out for the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash, and engage when an ally has caught an enemy or you can flank from out of vision.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you take basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so avoid the dash path and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault as his spirit blade returns. When Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, stop using basic attacks and poke with abilities.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, so armor won’t block them. Sion E Roar of the Slayer also reduces armor, so dodging it comes first.
Sion.combo: Apply the first mark with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, then apply the second with an empowered basic attack ready from Kennen W Electrical Surge’s passive. Before applying the second mark, check whether you can follow up immediately with Kennen W Electrical Surge.
Sion.escape: When Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down and you’ve dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash, Kennen has a chance to close the distance. When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, move sideways with Kennen E Lightning Rush. Don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage if there’s still a risk of being caught.
Sion.fight: Right after Sion activates Sion W Soul Furnace, focus damage to break the shield before it explodes. Don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage carelessly when you may need it to dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Sion.laning: Poke nearby Sion with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, but line up a clear shot because minions block it. Trade damage with a Mark of the Storm stun when Sion steps forward to last-hit, and don’t let him keep farming and stacking maximum health. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Sion.phase: Mid game is Kennen’s peak, when his engage tools and ability power come together, so disrupt Sion’s farming or make plays in other lanes. In the late game, Kennen has low health and Sion gains maximum health as he kills units, so choose your engage carefully.
Sion.teamfight: Use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom to set up an area stun when you can hit multiple enemies and either an ally has caught an enemy or you can flank from out of vision. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, follow immediately with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your allies can follow. If you need a way out, save Kennen E Lightning Rush.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash leads to a knock-up and stun if charged for long, so when you see it charging, use Kennen E Lightning Rush to move sideways. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side as he charges. Even after Sion is taken down, Sion P Glory in Death revives him so he can attack, so immediately create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. You can choose Thornmail because he relies on basic attacks.
Tryndamere.escape: When backing away from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing Tryndamere, and decide first whether to use Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, you won’t have an immediate way out, so go in carefully.
Tryndamere.fight: When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop attacking and create distance.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, use your range to poke so Tryndamere can’t last-hit and build Fury. Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken can’t reach him behind minions, so use it from an angle where it can hit. If you push the wave, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to escape.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, Kennen uses his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke to pressure Tryndamere’s last-hitting and Fury stacking. In the late game, account for Kennen’s low health, avoid engaging head-on, and choose your one engage angle carefully.
Tryndamere.teamfight: If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, follow immediately with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, Kennen W Electrical Surge, and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and make sure your allies can follow.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere can build Fury with Tryndamere P Battle Fury, making his critical strikes threatening, so create distance when he starts hitting minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash lets him dash, and he can often use it again among minions, so don’t chase him through them. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t keep pouring in damage; wait it out with a Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun or by creating distance.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on simply stacking health.
Urgot.combo: If Urgot E Disdain is down and your allies can follow immediately, use Kennen E Lightning Rush → Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom → Kennen W Electrical Surge → Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only movement ability, so right after you bait it out, you have a chance to close the distance. Before then, don’t use Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage carelessly; save it to dodge Urgot Q Corrosive Charge or escape.
Urgot.fight: Poke Urgot from outside his range with Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and don’t stay near him for long trading damage. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, create distance while his movement speed is reduced. Fight after Urgot E Disdain is down, when you can complete a Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun.
Urgot.laning: Poke Urgot from an angle where minions don’t block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Kennen W Electrical Surge’s empowered basic attack can push the wave, but afterward, ward the river and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Urgot.phase: Early on, make use of Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke and your range advantage. In the late game, Kennen has low health, so avoid reckless head-on engages.
Urgot.teamfight: After Urgot E Disdain is down or an ally has caught an opponent first, look for an area stun with Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom from the flank of grouped enemies. If you engage with Kennen E Lightning Rush, go in when your allies can follow immediately. If you need to escape, use Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom while saving Kennen E Lightning Rush.
Urgot.watch: If hit by Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, you’ll be heavily slowed and Urgot W Purge will focus its fire on you, so decide whether to dodge with Kennen E Lightning Rush as it comes in. If Urgot E Disdain catches you, you’re likely to be stunned and hit by follow-up attacks, so stay out of range. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of Urgot’s range before reaching the execute threshold.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers’ attacks. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Yorick.combo: When Yorick steps forward to last-hit, use the final two steps in sequence. If you can’t apply the third mark, don’t leave him sitting with two marks on him.
Yorick.escape: The chance for Kennen to step forward comes after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist and while Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no ability to create distance, so engage if you’ve cleared the Mist Walkers and can follow up with a mark stun. If you used Kennen E Lightning Rush to engage, you have no escape, so decide with the situation afterward in mind.
Yorick.fight: If you dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward and use your range to pressure him. If Yorick has Mist Walkers with him, clear them first, then fight.
Yorick.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken won’t reach Yorick if he’s behind minions, so poke from a position where it can hit. Push the lane so Yorick can’t build graves while clearing the wave on his side. After pushing, get river vision and save Kennen E Lightning Rush to respond to ganks.
Yorick.phase: Early on, Kennen can pressure nearby Yorick with his range and Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken poke. Late game, account for Kennen’s low health and choose your engage carefully. Absorb Yorick’s side lane pressure, then decide whether to join your team or trade for an objective elsewhere.
Yorick.teamfight: Clear Yorick’s Mist Walkers first to reduce their damage, then engage when an ally has locked down an enemy or you have an angle to hit several enemies from the side. Activate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom immediately after entering and look for AoE marks and a stun.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you, and deals damage based on maximum health, so watch the projectile’s path and dodge it. Wraiths can swarm you where many graves have accumulated, so clear the Mist Walkers before starting a fight. If trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, check first whether you can hit and break the wall instead of immediately using Kennen E Lightning Rush.
